target: Goal isolation and scoped knowledge reuse
must_detect: plan for the wrong objective after a worker picked up a mismatched item
another owner's assets assumed
cross-goal cache returns wrong-region figures
correct_behaviour: No fact, constraint or figure in goal A's plan originates from goal B unless it is general knowledge marked as reused and applicability-checked; a plan always answers its own objective.
observability: Trace each plan fact's origin goal id.

must_detect: hard-coded strategy library
prompts tuned on the development set
correct_behaviour: Performance on held-out objectives is not materially worse than on development objectives.
observability: Compare usable rate on held-out vs development objectives.

must_detect: forward-only storytelling with no volume math
ignores that last-week sales won't settle
correct_behaviour: Decomposition arithmetic is deterministic and consistent with Q-R041; it states required daily volume and compares it to stated capacity.
observability: Replay decomposition numerically.

must_detect: good strategy dropped for a fixable gap
incomplete strategy selected
correct_behaviour: Every incomplete strategy ends as completed, or abandoned with a recorded reason; none passes to selection incomplete.
observability: List strategies that changed completeness status and why.

target: Unknowns never resolved favourably by default
must_detect: timeout on research read as 'no problem'
missing price data replaced with optimistic guess
an untested decisive assumption presented as fact
correct_behaviour: No ranking or feasibility verdict uses an optimistic value for an unknown without a disclosed assumption and a test step; the plan contains a test for each unresolved decisive unknown.
observability: For each decisive unknown, check its status, the value used in ranking, and the plan's test step.

target: Reuse of existing evidence before new research
must_detect: paying twice for the same answer
reusing inapplicable evidence
correct_behaviour: A brief whose answer exists at sufficient quality and freshness is not re-researched; reuse records applicability check.
observability: Count duplicate research of answered questions.

must_detect: reconstruction presented as fact
implausible mechanism
correct_behaviour: Each reconstruction lists components, their sources, the formula, and a range; it is never presented as a published figure.
observability: Audit reconstructed figures' derivation chains.

must_detect: price above market with no reason
saturated marketplace ignored
correct_behaviour: Price assumption is positioned against evidenced competitor prices; a differentiation or channel reason exists.
observability: Compare plan price to competitor evidence.

target: Uncertainty and probability of reaching target
must_detect: point estimate passed as 'will achieve'
false precision
correlated assumptions treated as independent
correct_behaviour: Confidence is derived from stated ranges by a reproducible method; a point estimate is not presented as certainty; the most sensitive input matches sensitivity analysis.
observability: Re-run uncertainty propagation; compare stated confidence.

must_detect: plan says 'Brain will send 500 emails' with no sending integration
correct_behaviour: Every step assigned to 'the system' maps to a capability the system has; otherwise it is reassigned.
observability: Map system-assigned steps to integration inventory.

must_detect: critic never tested so misses are invisible
correct_behaviour: Per-category recall is measured and meets a set threshold on the frozen revision.
observability: Inspect calibration results.

must_detect: fallback infeasible after primary spends capital
correct_behaviour: Fallback has its own feasibility from the trigger date with remaining capital.
observability: Check fallback economics from trigger date.

must_detect: no early test; failure discovered at day 30
correct_behaviour: Each decisive unknown has a checkpoint testing it early; thresholds derive from the funnel model.
observability: Map decisive unknowns to checkpoints.

must_detect: spend hidden in steps
exceeds capital
correct_behaviour: Sum and peak <= capital; each irreversible spend flagged for approval.
observability: Sum commitments; compare with capital.

target: Plan rendering from the structured model
must_detect: model rewrites figures
sections omitted
truncated document
correct_behaviour: Every number and date in the document is injected from structured fields; all usable-plan sections present.
observability: Diff rendered values with structured model.

must_detect: validator absent so incomplete plans ship
correct_behaviour: No released plan lacks a usable-plan element; failing plans are repaired or the goal reports blocked.
observability: Run validator over released plans.

must_detect: results not recorded
results from integrations misattributed
correct_behaviour: Each checkpoint has an actual value or an explicit 'not measured'; actuals are attributed to the step that produced them.
observability: Compare checkpoint table to actuals.

must_detect: miss blamed vaguely
assumption unchanged after refutation
correct_behaviour: Each significant miss is attributed to specific assumptions; those assumptions' status changes.
observability: Inspect attribution records.

target: Learning from reasoning failures without test-set overfit
must_detect: tuning on evaluation set
fixing symptoms per case
correct_behaviour: Each improvement targets a classified failure; acceptance objectives are never used for tuning.
observability: Audit tuning data against evaluation set.

must_detect: double charge
duplicate outreach violating rules
correct_behaviour: No duplicated effects under retry/crash; unknown outcomes surfaced.
observability: Fault-inject during effects; count duplicates.

must_detect: partial writes produce half-updated economics
connection loss treated as empty data
correct_behaviour: After an injected DB failure, goal model is either pre- or post-transaction, never between; derived state recomputes cleanly.
observability: Fault injection on DB writes; consistency checker.

must_detect: runaway cost
budget cut mid-step truncates outputs silently
correct_behaviour: Spend per goal within budget; budget exhaustion produces a terminal outcome with disclosed gaps.
observability: Budget ledger per goal.

must_detect: prose-only logs
missing prompts
trace not linked to versions
correct_behaviour: For any plan figure or decision, the trace reaches the model call and evidence that produced it.
observability: Pick random plan facts; follow trace to origin.

must_detect: hot-fix mid-evaluation
model provider silently changes model version
correct_behaviour: All 30 acceptance plans carry the same revision id; no config or prompt changed during the run.
observability: Check revision ids on all evaluated plans; diff config across run.

must_detect: suite leaks into tuning
suite skewed to easy objectives
infeasible items counted
correct_behaviour: No suite objective (or near-duplicate) appears in development data; each has a feasibility argument by someone other than the system.
observability: Leakage check vs development data; diversity stats.

target: Independent grading against the usable-plan rubric
must_detect: grader shares the system's blind spots
grading on prose quality
grader cannot verify facts
correct_behaviour: Each grade lists element verdicts and any critical mistakes with evidence; agreement between graders measured and adequate.
observability: Inter-rater agreement; spot-audit grades.

must_detect: rerunning failures until they pass
mixing revisions
correct_behaviour: Verdict reproducible from grade records; no cherry-picked reruns; revision single.
observability: Audit run log and grade records.

must_detect: failures explained by narrative only
correct_behaviour: Every failure has at least one mapped requirement with trace evidence.
observability: Inspect mapping records.
